import zipfile, shutil
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

SRC = 'sales_data.xlsx'
DST = 'sales_data_out.xlsx'
NS = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'
ET.register_namespace('', NS)

def q(tag): return f'{{{NS}}}{tag}'

with zipfile.ZipFile(SRC) as zin:
    entries = {n: zin.read(n) for n in zin.namelist()}

# --- sheet1.xml ---
root = ET.fromstring(entries['xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'])

root.set('ref', 'A1:H10')  # dimension element uses 'ref'
dim = root.find(q('dimension'))
dim.set('ref', 'A1:H10')

cols = root.find(q('cols'))
col = ET.SubElement(cols, q('col'))
col.set('min', '8'); col.set('max', '8'); col.set('width', '15'); col.set('customWidth', '1')

sheet_data = root.find(q('sheetData'))
rows = sheet_data.findall(q('row'))

# Header H1
hdr = rows[0]
h1 = ET.SubElement(hdr, q('c'))
h1.set('r', 'H1'); h1.set('s', '1'); h1.set('t', 'inlineStr')
is_el = ET.SubElement(h1, q('is')); t_el = ET.SubElement(is_el, q('t'))
t_el.text = 'Profit Margin %'

# Data rows H2..H9 and total H10
for r in rows[1:]:
    rn = int(r.get('r'))
    cell = ET.SubElement(r, q('c'))
    cell.set('r', f'H{rn}')
    cell.set('s', '3' if rn < 10 else '4')
    f = ET.SubElement(cell, q('f')); f.text = f'G{rn}/E{rn}'
    ET.SubElement(cell, q('v'))  # empty cached value; recalc fills it

entries['xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'] = ET.tostring(root, encoding='UTF-8', xml_declaration=True)

# --- styles.xml ---
sroot = ET.fromstring(entries['xl/styles.xml'])

numfmts = sroot.find(q('numFmts'))
numfmt = ET.SubElement(numfmts, q('numFmt'))
numfmt.set('numFmtId', '164'); numfmt.set('formatCode', '0.0%')
numfmts.set('count', '1')

cellxfs = sroot.find(q('cellXfs'))
xf1 = ET.SubElement(cellxfs, q('xf'))
xf1.set('numFmtId', '164'); xf1.set('fontId', '0'); xf1.set('fillId', '0')
xf1.set('borderId', '0'); xf1.set('pivotButton', '0'); xf1.set('quotePrefix', '0')
xf1.set('xfId', '0'); xf1.set('applyNumberFormat', '1')
xf2 = ET.SubElement(cellxfs, q('xf'))
xf2.set('numFmtId', '164'); xf2.set('fontId', '1'); xf2.set('fillId', '0')
xf2.set('borderId', '0'); xf2.set('pivotButton', '0'); xf2.set('quotePrefix', '0')
xf2.set('xfId', '0'); xf2.set('applyNumberFormat', '1')
cellxfs.set('count', '5')

entries['xl/styles.xml'] = ET.tostring(sroot, encoding='UTF-8', xml_declaration=True)

# --- write new zip ---
with zipfile.ZipFile(DST, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:
    for name, data in entries.items():
        zout.writestr(name, data)

print('wrote', DST)
